name: YouTube to Twitter Thread
description: Paste a YouTube link, get back a ready-to-post Twitter thread that pulls out the best moments and links back to the full video.
seoTitle: AI YouTube to Twitter Thread Converter
seoDescription: Turn a YouTube video transcript into a ready-to-post Twitter/X thread — hook-first, character-count checked, in your own voice. Free.
long_description:
Most creators promote a new video on Twitter/X with a title and a link — and it gets ignored, because it reads like an ad, not a post. YouTube to Twitter Thread fixes that by extracting the 5-7 strongest standalone moments from your video's transcript and writing them as a real thread: a scroll-stopping hook, one idea per tweet, and a close that links back to the full video as 'more detail' instead of repeating what was already said.

Key capabilities:
- Extracts standalone insights instead of chopping a video description into 280-character pieces
- Writes a hook-first opening tweet built to stop a scroll, not announce a video
- Checks every tweet against the 280-character limit before it ships
- Preserves your actual phrasing and tone from the transcript instead of flattening it into generic listicle language
- Refuses to guess from a bare URL — asks for a transcript or detailed summary instead of generating a generic thread

Perfect for YouTubers who already post on Twitter/X to promote new videos but currently do it by hand, or skip it because writing a good thread takes longer than it should.

Example: Paste your video transcript in. Get back a numbered thread that opens with your strongest claim, breaks the video's key points into standalone tweets in your own words, and closes with a one-line recap plus your video link — ready to copy and post in under two minutes.
author: CreatorSkills
